checkpoint: last actual optimizer update; no EMA/best selection
microbatches_per_update: 24 synthetic in all arms; then 8 real in C1/C2
loss_scaling: canonical batch-summed loss; synthetic and real gradients accumulated for exactly one SGD step; no implicit nbs accumulation
augmentation: V3 canonical settings; independent domain datasets; deterministic per-image RNG; mosaic off for final 3 of 10 epochs
paired_order: per-seed/per-epoch permutation; 90 updates per epoch; actual transformed image/target hashes recorded
real_source: byte-identical existing V3A_TRUE_IGNORE 273 pseudo labels; no new filtering
C2: actual module-object box/cls parameter allowlist, backbone/neck/pose frozen, frozen BN eval; real criterion detection-only and receives no keypoints
success: 3-seed mean C2 AP50-95>C0; recover >=70% C1 gain if positive; common-frame kp median/P90/gross20 nonworse; no catastrophic pose regression
catastrophic_pose_regression: relative median translation or yaw degradation >10%, or pose coverage reduction >1 percentage point versus C0
note: New paired bounded comparison, not exact reproduction of V3 mixed-domain batch BN statistics. All arms share the same synthetic microbatch and actual-update schedule. Frozen pose does not guarantee unchanged post-selection keypoints.
